label: Peplink AP One AX Lite Wi-Fi 6 access point (APO-AX-LITE)
description: Peplink AP One AX Lite - ceiling-mount dual-band Wi-Fi 6 access point with one Gigabit Ethernet port, 2x2 MU-MIMO on both radios (2.4 GHz to 574 Mbps, 5 GHz to 1200 Mbps), built-in omni antennas, plenum-rated enclosure. Powered by 12 V DC jack or 802.3at PoE, 14.5 W maximum.
notes: The Lite differs from the AP One AX in three ways that a spec must not blur: **1G** copper instead of 2.5G, **2x2** radios instead of 4x4 (574 + 1200 Mbps against 1148 + 2400), and **14.5 W** maximum instead of 23 W. It still asks for **802.3at** PoE, so an 802.3af PSE cannot power it even though the draw is under 15.4 W - the PoE class is what the vendor states, and the engine should refuse an 802.3af port rather than quietly fitting it. Mains or PoE: the 12 V DC jack is on the box, with adapter and injector sold separately. Management is web admin and InControl only, so no `cli`.
